panels.description: api 业务日志 event=sbx_create_attempt 计数。沙箱创建的"发起"次数(进入创建逻辑)。口径对齐 e2b-sbx-create-teams。

url_options.data: {"topic": "1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705", "query": "service:orchestration-api and event:sbx_create_attempt | select count(*) as c", "from": "${__from}", "to": "${__to}", "limit": 1000}

panels.title: 创建尝试 (event)

panels.description: api 业务日志 event=sbx_create_success 计数。沙箱创建"成功"次数。

url_options.data: {"topic": "1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705", "query": "service:orchestration-api and event:sbx_create_success | select count(*) as c", "from": "${__from}", "to": "${__to}", "limit": 1000}

panels.title: 创建成功 (event)

panels.description: api 日志 message="Failed to create sandbox" 计数。节点层(orchestrator placement)创建失败,即异步阶段的真实失败日志(此时 HTTP 请求已返回 2xx)。

url_options.data: {"topic": "1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705", "query": "* | select count(*) as c where message = ~SQ~Failed to create sandbox~SQ~", "from": "${__from}", "to": "${__to}", "limit": 1000}

panels.title: 创建失败 (Failed to create sandbox)

panels.description: 端到端成功率 = success / attempt。反映"发起创建最终成功"的比例。缺口(attempt−success)含节点层失败 + 用户取消/超时等无失败日志的情况。

url_options.data: {"topic": "1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705", "query": "service:orchestration-api and (event:sbx_create_attempt or event:sbx_create_success) | select round(100.0 * sum(case when event=~SQ~sbx_create_success~SQ~ then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when event=~SQ~sbx_create_attempt~SQ~ then 1 else 0 end),0), 3) as rate", "from": "${__from}", "to": "${__to}", "limit": 1000}

panels.title: 端到端成功率

panels.description: 平台成功率 = success /(success + 节点层失败)。只用"有结果"的事件做分母,衡量平台侧创建可靠性,不含用户取消类。

url_options.data: {"topic": "1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705", "query": "* | select round(100.0 * sum(case when event=~SQ~sbx_create_success~SQ~ then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when event=~SQ~sbx_create_success~SQ~ then 1 else 0 end) + sum(case when message=~SQ~Failed to create sandbox~SQ~ then 1 else 0 end),0), 3) as rate", "from": "${__from}", "to": "${__to}", "limit": 1000}

panels.title: 平台成功率 (success / (success+节点层失败))
按 team 的创建成功(api 日志 teamID)

panels.description: 按 team 的创建明细。teamID/尝试/成功来自 api 日志 event 聚合,team 名称经 PostgreSQL teams 表 join。成功率=成功/尝试(窗口边界可能略>100%,属 attempt 与 success 跨窗口错配)。

url_options.data: {"topic":"1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705","query":"service:orchestration-api and event:sbx_create_success | select teamID, count(*) as success group by teamID order by success desc limit 200","from":"${__from}","to":"${__to}","limit":1000}

{"topic":"1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705","query":"service:orchestration-api and event:sbx_create_attempt | select teamID, count(*) as attempt group by teamID order by attempt desc limit 200","from":"${__from}","to":"${__to}","limit":1000}

端到端创建失败 · 详细日志(节点层 Failed to create sandbox · api 内部错误口径)

panels.description: 端到端创建失败明细(按 sandbox 聚合,每个失败 sandbox 一行)。sandboxID 从失败日志 attributes 正则抽;状态码=gRPC 错误码([Internal]/[FailedPrecondition] 等);teamID 经 ClickHouse sandbox_events 反查;team 名称由 value mapping 显示。无 sandboxID 的失败(多为 [Unavailable]/[Canceled])聚为空 sandbox 一行。注意:B 的 CH IN 列表与 teamID value mapping 需随新增失败 sandbox/team 更新。

url_options.data: {"topic":"1017a24d-a245-4e6a-830d-c19e76aeb705","query":"message:~SQ~Failed to create sandbox~SQ~ | select regexp_extract(attributes, '([a-z0-9]{20,})', 1) as sandboxID, count(*) as 失败次数, max(from_unixtime(__time__/1000)) as 最近失败时间, max(regexp_extract(attributes, '\"exception.message\":\"([^\"]+)\"', 1)) as 失败原因, max(regexp_extract(attributes, '\"build.id\":\"([^\"]+)\"', 1)) as buildID, max(node) as node group by sandboxID order by 失败次数 desc limit 200","from":"${__from}","to":"${__to}","limit":1000}
